intent.audience: Developers and platform engineers running GitHub Actions on hardware they control.
intent.surface: Public GitHub Pages landing page and CLI reference.
intent.outcome: Visitors understand the one-host, many-disposable-runners model and can choose a setup path within the first viewport.
intent.success: The site is distinctive, technically credible, accessible, responsive, and grounded in repository evidence.

existingSystem.content: Hero, capabilities, scale sets, quick start, agent plugin, backends, call to action, and command reference.
existingSystem.visualState: Dark navy, cyan, lime, system typography, hard-edged layout, and placeholder artwork.

direction.name: Runner Yard
direction.thesis: One physical host coordinates many clean, parallel jobs.
direction.signature: Parallel cobalt runner lanes moving through a single hard-edged host chassis.
direction.texture: Flat spot colors, hard rules, sharp corners, and restrained halftone only inside large illustrations.

interaction.behavior: Static navigation, anchor links, horizontal code overflow, and stacked mobile composition.
interaction.motion: No required motion. Reduced-motion users receive no smooth scrolling.

constraints.accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA, keyboard skip link, visible focus, one h1 per route, semantic landmarks, and 200 percent zoom support.
constraints.performance: Static output, no client JavaScript, responsive optimized hero, locally served fonts, and bounded image weight.
constraints.content: Preserve all verified product claims, commands, links, skills, and examples. Do not fabricate customers, metrics, or screenshots.
constraints.security: No third-party runtime scripts, no secrets, and no model-generated text embedded in technical diagrams.
constraints.brand: No GitHub, operating-system, hardware-vendor, or third-party marks in generated artwork.

reuse: Existing semantic HTML and product copy

states.default: Desktop and mobile screenshots plus route smoke tests.
states.hover: Computed contrast and visible style change.
states.focus-visible: Keyboard tab order and focus-ring inspection.
states.active: Link and button active-state CSS inspection.

breakpoints.375: Mobile layout, navigation, code overflow, and image crop.
breakpoints.1280: Desktop hierarchy, copy-safe hero, and full navigation.
